title: Installation
questions: How do I add it to my site?

clarification.question: Which platform is your site built on?

title: Install on Astro
questions: How do I install it on Astro?
answer: Run `npx astro add askstatic` and add the <AskStatic /> component to a layout.

title: Install on WordPress
questions: How do I install it on WordPress?
answer: Upload the plugin zip in Plugins > Add New and activate it.

title: Install on plain HTML
questions: How do I install it on a static HTML site?
answer: Copy the script tag from the docs into your page footer.

title: Pricing
answer: There is a free plan for personal sites. Paid plans start at $9 per month.

title: Refund policy
answer: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase.

title: Supported languages
answer: English and Bulgarian are built in. Other languages can be added with a language pack.

title: Privacy and data
questions: Does it collect my visitors' data?
answer: Nothing is sent anywhere. All matching happens in the visitor's browser.

title: Requirements
questions: Which Astro version do I need?
answer: Astro 5 or newer and Node 22.12 or newer.

title: Customising the look
questions: How do I change the colors?
Can I style the chat widget?
answer: Override the CSS variables such as --askstatic-accent on the widget element.

title: Writing knowledge entries
questions: How do I add questions and answers?
What is the knowledge file format?
answer: Put one YAML or JSON file per topic in src/askstatic with questions, an answer and sources.

title: Full-site search fallback
questions: Can it search my whole site?
What happens when there is no answer?
answer: When no entry matches, the widget shows Pagefind results from the rest of your site.

title: Does it use AI?
questions: Is there a language model behind it?
answer: No. Answers are selected from your own pre-written entries; no model runs in the browser or on a server.

title: Performance and size
questions: Will it slow down my site?
answer: Nothing loads until the chat is opened. The engine and index are fetched on first use.

title: License
answer: MIT licensed. Commercial use is allowed.
